que_es: Amount of matter in the body; in 0 g it is not weighed, its inertia is measured.

como_se_mide_en_vuelo.estacion: Inertial device (SLAMMD or BMMD), body rigid and secured to the guide arm. Note which one.
como_se_mide_en_vuelo.superficie: Scale with correction for local gravity.

por_que: HRP risk: inadequate food and nutrition.
referencia_en_vuelo: In 25 crew members the mean loss was 4.4% according to BMMD and 2.8% according to SLAMMD; SLAMMD has an accuracy of 0.2 kg. Masses from different instruments are not compared without noting it.
cuando_avisar: Sustained drift from the baseline (layer C).
prevencion: Adequate energy and fluid intake, and foods that are varied and acceptable to the crew, to avoid weight loss in flight.
fuentes: NASA HRP: Risks of Human Spaceflight
